# elemento_aiserverless (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento aiserverless resource on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID for the resource.
- `arn` (String) ARN of the resource.
- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `enable_streaming` (Boolean) Whether responses are streamed.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `model_id` (String) ID of the model being served.
- `model_name` (String) Name of the model to serve.
- `name` (String) Name of the AI serverless endpoint.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key for the resource.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
